authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture, Govt of India
benefit: ₹6,000 per annum credited in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank accounts

criteria.label: Ownership of cultivable agricultural landholding
criteria.plain_description: The farmer household must own cultivable agricultural land registered in official land revenue records.
criteria.source_clause: PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines Clause 2.1 (Definition of Beneficiary)
criteria.remediation: Upload a valid Land Record (RoR / Khasra / Khatauni) in the applicant's name.

criteria.label: Non-institutional landholder exclusion check
criteria.plain_description: Institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, and high-pension government retirees are excluded.
criteria.remediation: Confirm applicant is an individual/family small farmer and not an institutional entity.

criteria.label: Mandatory Aadhaar identity verification
criteria.plain_description: Applicant must possess a valid Aadhaar card for biometric authentication and direct benefit transfer (DBT).
criteria.remediation: Upload a copy of applicant's Aadhaar Card.

criteria.label: Income tax payer exclusion check
criteria.plain_description: Household members should not have paid income tax in the last assessment year.
criteria.remediation: Provide self-declaration or Income Certificate proving non-taxpayer status.

application.office_name: Common Service Centre (CSC) or Block Agricultural Office (DAO)
documents_to_carry: Original Aadhaar Card with active mobile number linked
Nationalized Bank Passbook showing active Aadhaar NPCI seeding
process_steps: Verify that bank account has NPCI Aadhaar seeding enabled at your bank branch
Submit online registration at pmkisan.gov.in or visit the nearest CSC kiosk
State Nodal Officer / Patwari will verify physical land records within 15 days
Subsequent installments credited directly into seeded bank account
